meta.title: Why eMudhra Shares Crashed 40% & The Master Key Leak Explained | Rajan का ADDA
meta.description: What is eMudhra? What does the intermediate CA private key leak mean, why did browsers block them, why did shares fall 40%, and will eMudhra recover? Complete technical breakdown in Hindi with first-principles cryptography and market impact analysis.
facts_to_verify: eMudhra Intermediate CA private key was generated with small scalar d=4 (secp384r1)
Mozilla OneCRL revoked affected intermediates in 2h 53m
Google Chrome, Apple, and Microsoft distrusted compromised certificates
eMudhra stock dropped ~40% hitting lower circuits from ~₹600 to ~₹340
Global SSL was ~1% of revenue; domestic Indian DSC/eSign (MCA-21, Income Tax, GST) is completely air-gapped and insulated
